items.statement: The report independently verifies the supplied G1 monomer and dimer identities and preserves object identity.
items.expected: 52-atom G1 monomer (+2, singlet) and 104-atom two-G1 dimer (+4, singlet) are explicitly checked.

items.statement: The selected computational route includes endpoint/stability validation for both systems.
items.expected: No imaginary frequencies are reported for optimized structures, or a justified equivalent stability test is documented.

items.statement: The independently computed monomer gives a twisted geometry descriptor pattern.
items.expected: Benzyl-pyridinium dihedrals near 50.67° and 50.65°, and pyridinium-naphthalene dihedrals near 30.28° and 30.27°.

items.statement: The independently computed dimer gives offset parallel packing descriptors.
items.expected: Ring center-to-center distance near 3.63 Å and slip angle near 44.89°.
